card.name: Closely after Monitor patients; sentence-opening Although
card.fires_on: The word "closely" right after "Monitor (such) patients" in opioid warnings. Also "Although" opening a sentence after a statement of adverse-event rates, and "particularly" after "closely,".

modes.label: The phrase "monitor closely"
modes.description: The adverb "closely" right after "Monitor patients" in warnings about respiratory depression.
modes.example: Monitor patients<< closely>> for respiratory depression, especially within the first

modes.label: "Although" opening a sentence
modes.description: "Although" begins a sentence right after a statement about adverse events or deaths in a trial.
modes.example: compared to a rate of about 2.6% in the placebo group.<< Although>> the causes of death were varied, most

modes.label: "Particularly" after "closely"
modes.description: "particularly" follows the comma after "Monitor such patients closely," and introduces the time to watch.
modes.example: Monitor such patients closely,<< particularly>> when initiating and titrating Pentazoc
